name: Angelic Brass War Helm
body:
Aura: moderate abjuration and transmutation; CL 9th; Slot: head; Price: 8,000 gp; Weight: 5 lb.

DESCRIPTION

Angelic brass war helms resemble polished brass and mithral alloy (“orichalcum”) versions of knight helms, crested Spartan helmets, or winged Norse helmets. The helm provides good-aligned wearers with a +1 deflection bonus to armor class and a +2 bonus on saves vs. gaze attacks, blinding and deafening attacks, sonic attacks, and fear effects.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells mage armor (or shield of faith), remove blindness-deafness, remove fear, resistance; Cost: 4,000 gp.
